code='''def transform(grid):
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8]
    fours=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==4]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    h=r1-r0+1; w=c1-c0+1
    if len(fours)<2: return [[8 if (r,c) in shape else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    dr=fours[1][0]-fours[0][0]; dc=fours[1][1]-fours[0][1]
    # Repeat perpendicular to the line joining the markers.
    sr,sc=dc,-dr
    import math
    g=math.gcd(abs(sr),abs(sc)); sr//=g; sc//=g
    # The marker spacing sets copy displacement.
    sr*=g; sc*=g
    copies=[(0,0),(sr,sc)]
    minr=min(a for a,b in copies); minc=min(b for a,b in copies)
    maxr=max(a+h for a,b in copies); maxc=max(b+w for a,b in copies)
    out=[[0]*maxc for _ in range(maxr)]
    for a,b in copies:
        for r,c in shape: out[a-minr+r][b-minc+c]=8
    return out
'''
